job.job_description:
`

We are hiring Backend Engineers (Python) to design, build, and scale backend services that power our B2B SaaS platform. This role is hands-on and focused on building reliable, secure, and high-performance systems that support enterprise-grade workloads.

You will work closely with Product, Frontend, and DevOps teams to deliver backend services used by customers at scale.

`,responsibilities:` Backend Development APIs
Design and develop backend services and REST APIs using Python
Build scalable, maintainable, and testable code for production environments
Implement business logic, workflows, and integrations with internal and external systems
Data Storage
Design and manage data models using relational and/or NoSQL databases
Optimize queries and improve performance for high-volume data access
Ensure data consistency, integrity, and reliability
System Reliability Performance
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues
Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for backend services
Participate in debugging, incident resolution, and root cause analysis
Security Best Practices
Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data-protection practices
Follow coding standards, testing practices, and documentation guidelines
Contribute to code reviews and technical design discussions
Collaboration Delivery
Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and trade-offs
Collaborate with Frontend and DevOps engineers on end-to-end delivery
Support CI/CD pipelines and production releases
Qualifications
3 6+ years of experience in backend development using Python
Strong experience building RESTful APIs and backend services
Hands-on experience with databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.)
Experience with frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI
Understanding of cloud-based architectures and production environments
Preferred Experience
Experience building SaaS platforms or enterprise-grade systems
Familiarity with message queues, background jobs, or event-driven systems
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Experience with system design for scalability and reliability
What We Offer
Opportunity to work on production systems used by global customers
Ownership of backend components and services
Collaborative engineering culture with strong code quality standards
CCompetitive compensation and benefits in Pune, India
`
